gloss: penetration rate; adoption rate; rate of spread

definitions.gloss: penetration rate; adoption rate; rate of spread
definitions.explanation: The percentage or proportion showing how widely something has spread or been adopted in a population.

examples.japanese: スマートフォンの{普及率|ふきゅうりつ}は{高|たか}い。
examples.english: The smartphone adoption rate is high.

examples.japanese: インターネットの{普及率|ふきゅうりつ}が{年々|ねんねん}{上昇|じょうしょう}している。
examples.english: The internet penetration rate is rising year after year.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}のエアコンの{普及率|ふきゅうりつ}は{世界的|せかいてき}に{見|み}ても{非常|ひじょう}に{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Japan's air conditioner adoption rate is very high even by global standards.

notes:
Combines {普及|ふきゅう} (spread/dissemination) and {率|りつ} (rate/ratio). Used in statistics, reports, and news to express how widely a product, technology, or practice has been adopted. The {率|りつ} suffix is productive and attaches to many nouns to form rate/ratio compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {普及率|ふきゅうりつ}が{高|たか}い: high adoption rate
- {普及率|ふきゅうりつ}が{低|ひく}い: low adoption rate
- {普及率|ふきゅうりつ}が{上|あ}がる: the adoption rate rises
- {普及率|ふきゅうりつ}を{調|しら}べる: to research the adoption rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {普及|ふきゅう}: spread/dissemination — the base noun without the rate component
- {浸透率|しんとうりつ}: penetration rate — more technical, used in marketing
- {利用率|りようりつ}: usage rate — focuses on actual use rather than ownership
